title: Distill proposal (one atomic candidate from a scheduled extraction run)

type.description: Knowledge type. decision/constraint/api-catalog are approved one-by-one; the rest may be batched.

title.description: One-line conclusion. Must be understandable without the surrounding conversation.

summary.description: Self-contained abstract written as a retrieval-friendly chunk prefix: entity + conclusion + why it matters.

body.description: Expanded body: 结论 / 依据 / 适用范围 / 代价与坑. Environment-specific details go into their own section.

sourceRefs.description: Evidence. At least one must be a VERBATIM quote (<=200 chars), e.g. "note: <原文片段>". Without evidence the proposal is treated as hallucinated.

origin.description: Marks scheduled-distillation output so it lands in the separate review queue.

originId.description: Batch id from `memhub distill run start`; groups every proposal of one run for review and rollback.

supersedes.description: Existing entry ids this proposal revises; approval bumps their version instead of forking a twin.

expires_at.description: Optional validity deadline for time-bound knowledge (aging review uses it).

confidence.description: Self-reported confidence. INFORMATIONAL ONLY — do not gate auto-promotion on it (models reliably inflate it). Use verifiable signals instead: evidence count, quote presence, conflict count.
